name: trader_contacts
summary: Every trader contact in the sky and every satellite dish with where it points. Read only.

help.text: Returns game_time_s, contacts and dishes. Whether a contact fits and can land on a pad: landing_pads. What it trades: trader_inventory. Aiming a dish: dish_aim.

contacts.text: Trader type, display name, shuttle, pad_size_tiles (the pad it needs), direction (a unit vector from the base, y up), elevation, min_power_to_resolve_w and min_power_to_contact_w, contacted, and time_left_s before it leaves.

dishes.text: forward: the vector the game scores contacts against (angle error = acos(dot(forward, direction))), updated only when the dish moves; transform_up: its pose. Also horizontal and vertical in degrees, whether it turns (finished, powered, on and can_rotate: the game's own check; a dish that cannot rotate never moves toward a written angle), field_of_view_deg, min_power_w and max_power_w.
